title: Bigger Rug, Bigger Rug Pull
summary: Last Friday, we described that day’s activity as a “rug pull.” On that day, we saw stocks rise in the pre-market and on the open, then sink quickly afterwards. Today, we’re seeing something similar, though after a much bigger early rally. Traders were clearly enthusiastic about the prospects for the much-awaited IPO[i] (it has still not opened as I type this), but that stock’s coattails were not long enough to drag the whole market along with it this morning.
